_comment: Correlated day-RGB + LWIR source streams behind data/aligned. Measured 2026-08-17 with ffprobe 4.x + a MISB ST 0601 KLV parser (commands in STREAMS.md). Regenerate rather than edit.

pts_delta_ms.note: jittery but no gaps > 60 ms -> no dropped frames

klv.timestamp_epoch: NOT unix epoch (values ~5.8e8 us); relative encoder clock shared with thermal.ts

thermal.role: LWIR thermal (network target B); 8-bit AGC video, NOT radiometric -> ThermalNorm rel8

sensor_first.note: alt 0.0 m = raw 2964 = unpopulated default at stream start

sync.evidence_shared_clock: both KLV timestamp series end within 9.6 ms of the same value (1294.7696 vs 1294.7600 s) despite different start times and durations; identical tag layout; identical sensor position

extract_frames_offset_ms.definition: thermal index-time (frame_idx/25) minus RGB index-time (frame_idx/30) for the same KLV instant = 583.255841 - 582.362509 s
extract_frames_offset_ms.meaning: thermal recording started ~0.893 s BEFORE the day recording; RGB frame 0 corresponds to thermal frame ~22
extract_frames_offset_ms.status: derived from telemetry, NOT yet validated by the hot-object procedure in README step 1 -- validate before relying on it
